descriptions.en: Path to the Git executable. An empty value first inherits VS Code's `git.path`; otherwise the system Git in the current runtime environment is used. This value cannot be set by a workspace.
descriptions.zhCN: Git 可执行文件路径。空值表示优先继承 VS Code 的 `git.path`，否则使用当前运行环境中的系统 Git。工作区不能设置该值。

descriptions.en: Repository discovery scope: `openFolders` detects only opened folders; `subFolders` scans subdirectories; `off` uses manually added repositories only. The whole disk is never scanned.
descriptions.zhCN: 仓库发现范围：`openFolders` 仅检测已打开 Folder；`subFolders` 扫描子目录；`off` 仅使用手动仓库。不会扫描整个磁盘。

descriptions.en: Maximum scan depth for `subFolders` mode, from 1 to 5. Higher values increase scan cost when opening large directories.
descriptions.zhCN: `subFolders` 模式的最大扫描层级，范围 1–5。数值越大，打开大型目录时扫描成本越高。

descriptions.en: In a multi-repository workspace, automatically follow the repository that owns the active editor file; when disabled, keep the user's selection.
descriptions.zhCN: 多仓库工作区中自动跟随当前编辑文件所属仓库；关闭后固定用户选择。

descriptions.en: `auto` adapts to available width; `compact` reduces row height and secondary information; `comfortable` keeps full information.
descriptions.zhCN: `auto` 根据宽度调整；`compact` 减少行高和次要信息；`comfortable` 保留完整信息。

en: Reduce row height and secondary information.

descriptions.en: Number of commits loaded at a time, from 50 to 1000. This does not limit total history.
descriptions.zhCN: 每次加载的 Commit 数量，范围 50–1000；不限制历史总量。

descriptions.en: Maximum branch lanes drawn at once, from 8 to 200. More distant lanes are collapsed to limit layout cost.
descriptions.zhCN: 同时绘制的最大分支轨道数，范围 8–200；超过后折叠远轨道以限制布局成本。

descriptions.en: `topo` preserves topology; `date` orders by commit time; `authorDate` orders by author time.
descriptions.zhCN: `topo` 保持拓扑；`date` 按提交时间；`authorDate` 按作者时间。

descriptions.en: Show Working Tree, Index, and uncommitted-change nodes at the top of the graph.
descriptions.zhCN: 在日志图顶部显示 Working Tree、Index 和未提交修改节点。

descriptions.en: Show remote-tracking branches in the graph and reference list. Disabling this only hides them; it does not delete or modify refs.
descriptions.zhCN: 是否在日志图与引用列表中显示远端跟踪分支；关闭只隐藏展示，不删除或修改 Ref。

descriptions.en: Show tags in the graph and reference list. Disabling this only hides them; it does not delete or modify tags.
descriptions.zhCN: 是否在日志图与引用列表中显示 Tag；关闭只隐藏展示，不删除或修改 Tag。

descriptions.en: Show stashes in the graph and reference list. Disabling this only hides them; it does not delete or pop stashes.
descriptions.zhCN: 是否在日志图与引用列表中显示 Stash；关闭只隐藏展示，不删除或弹出 Stash。

descriptions.en: Show associated worktrees and whether they are dirty.
descriptions.zhCN: 显示关联 Worktree 及其脏状态。

descriptions.en: `auto` uses merge-base only for branch-to-branch comparisons and Direct for other endpoint combinations; it can also be fixed to `direct` or `mergeBase`. The actual mode is always shown.
descriptions.zhCN: `auto` 仅对 Branch 对 Branch 使用 Merge-base，其他端点组合使用 Direct；也可固定 `direct` 或 `mergeBase`。实际模式始终显示。

descriptions.en: `none` shows all whitespace; `eol` ignores line endings; `all` ignores all whitespace. This affects viewing only and does not change the actual patch. The workbench can override it with a session-level shortcut.
descriptions.zhCN: `none` 显示全部；`eol` 忽略行尾；`all` 忽略全部空白。只影响查看，不改变实际 Patch。工作台可会话级快捷覆盖。

descriptions.en: `auto` detects within the performance budget; `on` always tries; `off` disables it. Degradation clearly shows additions and deletions.
descriptions.zhCN: `auto` 在性能预算内检测；`on` 始终尝试；`off` 关闭。降级时明确显示新增/删除。

descriptions.en: Maximum single-file size for generating a full text diff, from 1 to 1024 MB. Larger files show metadata and statistics only.
descriptions.zhCN: 可生成完整文本 Diff 的单文件大小上限，范围 1–1024 MB；超过后只显示元数据与统计。

descriptions.en: Maximum lines rendered initially for one diff, from 1000 to 200000. Larger diffs load in chunks and disable unnecessary decoration.
descriptions.zhCN: 单个 Diff 首次渲染的最大行数，范围 1000–200000；超过后按块加载并关闭非必要装饰。

descriptions.en: `prompt` asks every time; `worktree` writes the current workspace; `index` writes only the staging area; `newWorktree` applies in a new worktree.
descriptions.zhCN: `prompt` 每次询问；`worktree` 写当前工作区；`index` 只写暂存区；`newWorktree` 在新 Worktree 应用。

descriptions.en: Whether to stage all tracked changes automatically when the index is empty. Disabled by default to prevent unreviewed content from entering a commit.
descriptions.zhCN: 暂存区为空时是否自动 Stage 全部已跟踪修改。默认关闭，防止未审阅内容进入 Commit。

descriptions.en: `inherit` uses Git configuration and asks if it is unset; choose `prompt`, `ffOnly`, `merge`, or `rebase` to override it.
descriptions.zhCN: `inherit` 使用 Git 配置，未配置则询问；可选 `prompt`、`ffOnly`、`merge`、`rebase`。

descriptions.en: `inherit` uses Git configuration; `on` prunes stale remote-tracking refs; `off` disables pruning. Local branches are never deleted.
descriptions.zhCN: `inherit` 使用 Git 配置；`on` 清理失效远端跟踪 Ref；`off` 禁用。不会删除本地分支。

zhCN: 清理失效远端跟踪 Ref。

descriptions.en: Whether to fetch in the background. It updates remote-tracking refs only; it does not automatically pull, merge, or modify the workspace.
descriptions.zhCN: 是否后台 Fetch。只更新远端跟踪 Ref，不自动 Pull、Merge 或改工作区。

descriptions.en: Automatic fetch interval, from 5 to 1440 minutes. It pauses while unfocused, sleeping, or performing write operations.
descriptions.zhCN: 自动 Fetch 间隔，范围 5–1440 分钟；失焦、休眠或写操作时暂停。

descriptions.en: `prompt` asks; `keep` retains changes; `stash` creates a named stash; `newWorktree` creates a new worktree.
descriptions.zhCN: `prompt` 询问；`keep` 保留修改；`stash` 创建具名储藏；`newWorktree` 创建新 Worktree。

descriptions.en: Whether new stashes include untracked files by default. The actual scope is still shown before execution.
descriptions.zhCN: 创建 Stash 时默认是否包含 Untracked；执行前仍显示实际范围。

descriptions.en: `prompt` asks; `first` opens the first text conflict automatically; `never` shows only the banner and list.
descriptions.zhCN: `prompt` 询问；`first` 自动打开首个文本冲突；`never` 只显示横幅和列表。

en: Show the banner and list only.
zhCN: 自动打开首个文本冲突。

descriptions.en: `balanced` keeps normal operations short while previewing dangerous operations and creating checkpoints; `strict` adds confirmations and forbids rewriting published history. At runtime Global, Workspace, and Folder layers are read and the strictest value is used.
descriptions.zhCN: `balanced` 保持普通操作短路径，危险操作预览和检查点；`strict` 增加确认并禁止改写已发布历史。运行时读取 Global、Workspace、Folder 各层并取更严格值。

en: Preview dangerous operations and create checkpoints.
Add confirmations and forbid rewriting published history.
zhCN: 预览危险操作并建立检查点。
增加确认并禁止改写已发布历史。

descriptions.en: Protected branch globs. Normal commits and fast-forward pushes are allowed; deleting, resetting, rebasing, rewriting history, and force-pushing receive stronger checks. Rules are merged as a union across layers at runtime.
descriptions.zhCN: 受保护分支 Glob。正常 Commit/快进 Push 可用；删除、Reset、Rebase、历史改写和强推加强校验。运行时合并各层规则并取并集。

descriptions.en: `deny` prohibits rewriting published history; `confirm` shows the impact, requires a second confirmation, and permits only an exact lease. At runtime all layers are read and the strictest value is used; there is no always-allow option.
descriptions.zhCN: `deny` 禁止已发布历史改写；`confirm` 展示影响、二次确认并只允许精确 Lease。运行时读取各层并取更严格值，无“始终允许”。

en: Require impact preview, a second confirmation, and an exact lease.
zhCN: 要求影响预览、二次确认和精确 Lease。

descriptions.en: Retention days for recovery checkpoints, from 1 to 365. Only internal recovery data in the current local or remote environment is cleaned.
descriptions.zhCN: 恢复检查点保留天数，范围 1–365；只清理当前本机或 Remote 环境中的插件内部恢复数据。

descriptions.en: Maximum recovery checkpoints per repository, from 5 to 500. Once exceeded, the oldest unpinned checkpoint is cleaned.
descriptions.zhCN: 每仓库恢复检查点上限，范围 5–500；超过后清理最旧且未固定的检查点。

descriptions.en: Total recovery-data limit for the current Extension Host, from 256 to 102400 MB. Pinned or active checkpoints are not automatically deleted; when space is insufficient, dangerous operations are blocked and the recovery center opens instead of creating an incomplete snapshot.
descriptions.zhCN: 当前 Extension Host 的恢复数据总上限，范围 256–102400 MB。固定或活跃检查点不自动删除；空间不足时阻止新的危险操作并打开恢复中心，而不是创建不完整快照。

descriptions.en: `auto` adjusts based on repository size and Git latency; `balanced` retains more information; `largeRepository` prioritizes performance.
descriptions.zhCN: `auto` 根据仓库规模和 Git 延迟调整；`balanced` 保留更多信息；`largeRepository` 优先性能。

en: Adjust based on repository size and Git latency.
zhCN: 根据仓库规模和 Git 延迟调整。

descriptions.en: Global extension memory-cache limit, from 50 to 2048 MB. Once exceeded, LRU cleanup removes inactive repositories, old diffs, and graph pages.
descriptions.zhCN: 插件全局内存缓存上限，范围 50–2048 MB；超过后 LRU 清理非活动仓库、旧 Diff 和日志页。

descriptions.en: Global maximum read-only Git processes, from 1 to 8. Each repository has at most two read tasks, and writes are always serial.
descriptions.zhCN: 全局只读 Git 进程上限，范围 1–8；每仓库最多两个读任务，写操作始终串行。

descriptions.en: Local log level: `off/error/warn/info/debug/trace`. Trace must not record file contents, diffs, tokens, or credentials.
descriptions.zhCN: 本地日志级别：`off/error/warn/info/debug/trace`。Trace 也不得记录文件内容、Diff、令牌或凭据。

en: Log trace messages without sensitive data.
zhCN: 记录不含敏感数据的追踪信息。

descriptions.en: Hide usernames, absolute paths, repository names, and identifiable project information when exporting diagnostics. When disabled, path context needed for local export is retained; credentials, tokens, and URL passwords are always removed.
descriptions.zhCN: 导出诊断时隐藏用户名、绝对路径、仓库名和可识别项目信息。关闭后仅保留本地导出所需的路径上下文；凭据、Token 和 URL 密码仍始终删除。
